section1.title: 1. Services
section1.p1: Boxium is a one-stop marketplace platform designed for Pokémon Trading Card Game (PTCG) enthusiasts, collectors, and investors. The Platform integrates data from multiple global markets and provides a secure PSA 10 graded card secondary marketplace.
section1.p2: The services provided by the Platform include but are not limited to:
services: Card Research: Search card information and view PSA 10 historical transaction price trends
Price Lookup: Real-time display of PSA 10 listings, integrating SNKRDUNK and eBay market data
Market Trends: 24-hour trending rankings to track price movements in real time
Marketplace: PSA 10 graded card buy and sell trading platform
Seller Dashboard: Listing management, order management, and earnings tracking
Wishlist: Save target cards and track price changes
Image Search: Upload card images for intelligent recognition
section1.p3: The Platform reserves the right to modify, suspend, or terminate all or part of its services at any time without prior notice to users.

section3.title: 3. Marketplace Terms
section3.p1: The Platform provides a PSA 10 graded card secondary marketplace service, subject to the following specific terms:

subsection1.title: 3.1 Seller Responsibilities
items: Sellers must ensure that items listed are genuine PSA 10 graded cards and accurately describe the condition of the items
Sellers must complete shipment within the agreed timeframe after receiving payment
Sellers must complete Stripe Connect account setup before listing items on the Platform
Sellers must not list fraudulent items or engage in deceptive transactions
Sellers bear full responsibility for the authenticity, legality, and accuracy of descriptions of their listed items

subsection2.title: 3.2 Buyer Responsibilities
items: Buyers should carefully read item descriptions and seller reviews before purchasing
Once a buyer confirms receipt, the transaction is deemed complete
If a buyer does not confirm receipt within the specified time, the system will automatically complete the order
If a buyer has a dispute regarding an item, they must submit a dispute request within the specified time after receipt

subsection3.title: 3.3 Platform Role
items: The platform acts as an intermediary between buyers and sellers and does not guarantee product quality
The platform reserves the right to review and reject product listing applications
Transaction funds are held in escrow by the platform and transferred to the seller after the buyer confirms receipt
The platform charges a transaction fee of 5% of the final sale price, automatically deducted from the seller's payment upon transaction completion. The fee includes payment processing costs

refundPolicy: If an item significantly does not match its description, buyers may apply for a refund within 3 business days of receipt
